answer.reasoning: All five suggestions report the same defect. MetricAlertDetectorHandler (grouptype.py lines 11-12) was changed to inherit from StatefulDetectorHandler but only contains `pass`. It leaves the abstract methods unimplemented, so creating it raises TypeError. They list slightly different sets of missing methods: some name counter_names, get_dedupe_value and get_group_key_values, and s_d4d154ab wrongly names evaluate_group_key_value. That is the same defect described in different words, and one edit to the class fixes all of them. s_d4d154ab gives a file path that does not exist (workflow_engine/handlers/detector/grouptype.py), but it points at the same class at line 11 with the same `pass` body. It is a mislabeled path, not a real second location, so the group is same_location rather than cross_location. Every member reports one defect with one fix at one place, so no unified comment is needed.
